title: Connect verified learning to bounded engineering optimization candidates
problem: The production daily Self-Improvement observer reported nine READY compiler sources but zero optimization candidates, so verified learning could not reliably influence next engineering decisions.
root_cause: The daily observer read canonical projections but did not materialize bounded, non-executable follow-up candidates into the existing optimization registry.
decision: Extend the existing daily cron owner function, reuse compiler queue + existing optimization candidate registry, admit up to three idempotent review-required candidates per run.
fix: One protected SQL migration, fail-closed candidates, regression contract, System Map and skill update. No new scheduler, tenant data store or executor.
prevention_rule: A verified compiler source may produce only one bounded candidate per fingerprint, with explicit independent evaluation, no inferred business benefit, and no auto-dispatch or promotion.
expected_truth_after_release: Candidate count increases only after protected migration and daily owner run. CI/production readback and real outcome remain independently required.

invariants: no invented outcome or monetary value
